description: Why each setting is as it is: decisions/020-renovate.md
CI installs an exact npm, because Node 24's bundled npm is older than .npmrc's engine-strict accepts.
tests/unit/config/renovate.test.ts checks this pattern matches every npm@<version> in ci.yml.
Next's TypeScript plugin and the type check in next build use TypeScript's in-process JS API, which TypeScript 7 does not ship.
Lift this when TypeScript 7 has a stable JS API that Next supports. See decisions/012-project-init.md.
Node's types follow the Node line the app runs on, which .nvmrc names.
Raise this together with .nvmrc when the app moves to a newer even-numbered Node.
